p: Bring train 1 from cold iron to base load: auxiliaries, circulating water, oil systems, vacuum, the gas turbine, the HRSG warm-up, the steam turbine and loading.

text: Start instrument air compressor A (

p: Air-operated valves (the auxiliary boiler's burner, the control valves) need 4 bar to move.

text: Start closed cooling water pump A (
Put the closed cooling water cooler (
) in service.

p: Lube oil coolers, the vacuum pumps' seal water and the generator coolers all need it.

text: Check the cooling tower basin level (
) and put the makeup valve (
) in automatic.

p: The basin is the source of all circulating water.

text: Set the discharge valve of CW pump A (
) to its start position, 15 %.
Start circulating water pump A (

p: With the valve at its start position the empty pipe fills slowly, without a pressure surge, and the motor starts against a light load: its inrush current lasts four seconds.

text: Open the discharge valve fully within two minutes.

p: A pump running against a nearly closed valve for long overheats: the pump trips after 120 s.

text: Open the condenser water box vents (
to
) until water shows.

p: Air trapped in the top of the water boxes blinds tubes: the condenser loses vacuum later.

text: Close the four vents.
Check the hotwell level (
): the makeup keeps it near zero.
Start the steam turbine AC lube oil pump (
Reset the lube oil low-low trip now that the pressure is normal.
Start the jacking oil pump (

p: Jacking oil lifts the rotor on its bearings so the turning gear can turn it without wear.

text: Start the steam turbine turning gear (

p: A rotor left still sags; turning it slowly straightens it again. Watch the eccentricity fall.

text: Start the GT 1 AC lube oil pump (
) and reset its low-low trip.
Reset the GT 1 lube oil low-low trip.
Start the GT 1 turning gear (
Start the auxiliary boiler (
) and wait for 10 bar.

p: The first steam of a cold start comes from here.

text: Admit gland steam (

p: Only with the rotor turning: steam on a stopped rotor heats one side and bows it.

text: Start both vacuum pumps (
) and wait for the condenser pressure to fall below 12 kPa(a).

p: With gland steam on, air can't leak in along the shaft: the vacuum gets deep.

text: Reset the condenser pressure high-high trip.
Stop vacuum pump B: one pump holds the vacuum.
Open the condensate minimum flow valve (
Start condensate extraction pump A (

p: Until the HRSG takes condensate, the pump runs on its minimum flow line back to the condenser.

text: Open the HP superheater drains (
to
) and the start-up vent (

p: Steam condenses in the cold superheaters; the water must go before it reaches the turbine.

text: Start feedwater pump A (
). The HP drum level control is in automatic.
Put the HP and LP bypass (
) in automatic.

p: The bypass dumps the first steam into the condenser and holds the HRSG pressure. It needs the condenser: vacuum, circulating water and a condensate pump for its spray water.

text: Check the GT 1 start permissives on the screen, then start GT 1 (

p: Crank, purge the HRSG with five volume changes of air, ignite, accelerate: listen to the compressor whine rise.

text: Switch on the generator 1 excitation (
Raise the GT speed a little (+0.05 Hz) and watch the synchroscope turn.
Close the generator 1 breaker (
) as the pointer passes twelve o'clock.

p: The sync-check relay refuses a close outside ±10°, ±0.1 Hz and ±5 % voltage.

text: Hold GT 1 at minimum load and watch the HP drum pressure (
) and level rise.

p: The drum warms at about 3 K per minute; more load would warm it too fast.

text: Close the superheater drains and the start-up vent.
Wait until the steam turbine may roll: pressure, superheat, matching, eccentricity and vacuum.
Roll the steam turbine (

p: It warms at 800 rpm, then accelerates through the critical speeds without stopping.

text: Switch on the steam turbine generator excitation (
Raise the steam turbine speed a little and synchronise.
Close the steam turbine generator breaker (
Start cooling tower fans 1 to 5 as the heat load comes.
Raise GT 1 to base load, 250 MW (
): the bypass closes as the steam turbine takes the steam.
Bring circulating water pump B (
) in: valve to 15 %.
Start CW pump B.
Open its discharge valve.

p: A second pump halves the temperature rise in the condenser and deepens the vacuum, for 1.25 MW more pump power.

text: The train is at base load: the HP bypass is closed and the steam turbine carries the steam.
